import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import (
    train_test_split,
    RandomizedSearchCV,
    StratifiedKFold,
)
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Paths based on data overview provided
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)


# Helper function for multi-class log loss computation as per competition spec
def compute_multiclass_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    """Compute multi-class log loss as defined in competition"""
    eps = 1e-15
    p_clipped = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = p_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    p_normalized = np.where(row_sums > eps, p_clipped / row_sums, eps)
    return log_loss(y_true, p_normalized)


# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission.csv")

# Get feature columns (all non-id, non-species columns)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]

print(f"Feature columns loaded: {len(feature_cols)} columns")
print(f"Training samples: {len(train_df)}")
print(f"Test samples: {len(test_df)}")

# One-hot encode species labels for consistency
le = LabelEncoder()
train_df["species_encoded"] = le.fit_transform(train_df["species"])
num_classes = len(le.classes_)
y_train_unique = train_df["species_encoded"].values.astype(int)

# Create feature matrix and target from training data
X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
y_train = y_train_unique

# Split into train/validation (70/30) - keep training set larger but still sufficient for cv
X_train_final, X_holdout_val, y_train_final, y_holdout_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train, test_size=0.30, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)
print(
    f"\nTrain set size: {len(X_train_final)}, Validation set size: {len(X_holdout_val)}"
)

# Define reduced hyperparameter grid for faster RandomizedSearchCV
param_distributions = {
    "n_estimators": [100],
    "max_depth": [3, 5],
    "learning_rate": [0.1, 0.2],
    "subsample": [0.8, 1.0],
}

# Perform randomized search with fewer CV folds for speed
base_clf = GradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=42, verbose=0)
random_search = RandomizedSearchCV(
    estimator=base_clf,
    param_distributions=param_distributions,
    cv=StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3, shuffle=True, random_state=42),
    scoring="accuracy",
    n_iter=50,
    n_jobs=1,
    verbose=0,
    random_state=42,
    cv_results=False,
)
random_search.fit(X_train_final, y_train_final)

print(f"\nBest GB params: {random_search.best_params_}")
best_gb = random_search.best_estimator_

# Apply isotonic calibration ON TRAIN DATA ONLY
calibrated_clf = CalibratedClassifierCV(
    estimator=best_gb,
    method="isotonic",
    cv=StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42),
)
calibrated_clf.fit(X_train_final, y_train_final)

# Final evaluation on held-out validation set (NO refitting on validation data)
val_logloss = compute_multiclass_log_loss(
    y_holdout_val, calibrated_clf.predict_proba(X_holdout_val)
)
print(f"Held-out Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Prepare test predictions on UNLABELED TEST DATA
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
test_preds_proba = calibrated_clf.predict_proba(X_test)

# Normalize probabilities to ensure they sum to 1 per row (rescaling as per specs)
prob_sum = test_preds_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
probs_rescaled = np.zeros_like(test_preds_proba)
for i in range(test_preds_proba.shape[0]):
    prob_sum_i = prob_sum[i][0]
    probs_rescaled[i] = test_preds_proba[i] / prob_sum_i

# Clip probabilities to avoid extreme values
eps = 1e-15
probs_final = np.clip(probs_rescaled, eps, 1 - eps)

# Create submission dataframe using sample submission as template for column order
submission_rows = []
for i, img_id in enumerate(test_df["id"]):
    pred_row = [img_id] + [float(p) for p in probs_final[i]]
    submission_rows.append(pred_row)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    submission_rows, columns=["id"] + list(sample_sub.iloc[:, 1:])
)
submission_df.to_csv(f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv", index=False)

print("\nSubmission saved successfully to", SUBMISSION_DIR)
print("Final Held-out Validation Multi-class Log Loss:", val_logloss)
